create_responses: create a FastAPI endpoint that handles POST /v1/responses to generate AI model responses with streaming SSE support
retrieve_responses: retrieve a previously created AI response by its ID with optional pagination and streaming via GET /v1/responses/{response_id}
cancel_responses: cancel an in-progress AI response by its ID via POST /v1/responses/{response_id}/cancel
attach_router: attach the OpenAI Responses API router to a FastAPI application instance
convert_stream_to_sse_events: convert an async generator of streaming response events into Server-Sent Events format
